# The Copypasta:

>be me
>just want to hold this boy's hand
>I mean, even if it wasn't him, I just wanna hold a boy's hand at the hall
>be lined up against the walls of public rejection
>ostracized for being who I am
>whydoesanyonecare.jpg
>they literally hate us for loving
>that's so ironic it physically hurts
>mfw sitting there while people casually insult us like we don't exist
>like bro I'm RIGHT HERE
>any chance of social life I had before would be completely obliterated by coming out of this cage
>this fucking cage
>I just like to be a cute girly boy
>what's wrong with it
>WHAT'S WRONG WITH IT
>nothing, anon. absolutely nothing.
>tfw no boy's hand to hold
>tfw lined up against the wall
>tfw the cage stays locked another day
>why do they hate us for loving bros
>why do they hate us for loving

*[Reply 1]:* anon you're gonna make it. we're all gonna make it.

*[Reply 2]:* >cute girly boy
based and valid

*[Reply 3]:* anon please I can't take these feels at 3am

*[Reply 4]:* every single day with this pasta and every single day it hits just as hard
